risks: recipient/event/reason uniqueness alone permits separate reason rows for one causal assignment+mention; published one-Notification overlap criterion needs explicit cause grouping/reason precedence.
Spec leaves burst duration/grouping and ping-count bound unspecified. Exact coalescing contract must be accepted; fixed arbitrary debounce is not an evidenced product decision.

Database exactly-once notification creation is not exactly-once native OS side effect: crash between show and delivery receipt can duplicate or lose a popup. Root must reconcile external-effect uncertainty and separate durable Inbox guarantee from OS delivery proof.
Global team localStorage key/cache and local org fallback can leak records across workspace/principal changes unless projection scope is integrated.
pruneInboxState can erase local done marks after failed sources because loaded is set in finally; authoritative domain state must never be pruned by partial pagination or denied source results.

Adding a service only to Inbox leaves direct legacy reducer/store writers usable for shared targets; root single-writer fence is a real hidden gate.

General edited/deleted mentions and canonical task assignments belong to downstream producers; making them new WP-07 prerequisites would introduce a reverse dependency/cycle. Distinguish initial attention port proof from integrated CHAT-TASK-01 proof.
